name: MA-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Neal's large financial advantage ($3.3M cash vs ~$22K)
No polls or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Neal: a +8 Democratic lean plus incumbency and a massive fundraising edge, and markets price his win probability at 95%. With no polls or ratings to contradict the baseline, the safe-D assessment stands.
model.watch: Any late polling showing Milleron gaining traction, or a surge of outside spending against Neal, would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Nadia Milleron is an independent standing in for the Republican side.

overview:
Richard Neal, a longtime Democratic incumbent, is heavily favored in this western Massachusetts district, which leans Democratic by eight points. His only serious general-election opponent is independent Nadia Milleron, who has raised under $50,000 and held about $22,000, while Neal has raised $2.5 million and holds $3.3 million. Prediction markets put Neal's chances around 95 percent.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the money gap. Those all point the same way: a comfortable Democratic win with a margin near twenty points, though the absence of polling keeps uncertainty somewhat elevated.
